description: A shoulder tank in unpainted steel, a braided feed line, and a nozzle assembly that is mostly heat shielding. The pressure gauge is analogue, because a needle can be read through smoke and a display cannot. Stencilled down the tank in the manufacturer's flat civic typeface: VULCAN ORDNANCE - PYRE-3 INCINERATION PROJECTOR - LICENSED CLEARANCE WORK ONLY. Under that, in a different hand, scratched into the paint: IT DOES NOT KNOW WHAT YOU MEANT.
name: Vulcan Ordnance PYRE-3 incineration projector

__own.description: A shoulder tank in unpainted steel, a braided feed line, and a nozzle assembly that is mostly heat shielding. The pressure gauge is analogue, because a needle can be read through smoke and a display cannot. Stencilled down the tank in the manufacturer's flat civic typeface: VULCAN ORDNANCE - PYRE-3 INCINERATION PROJECTOR - LICENSED CLEARANCE WORK ONLY. __own.dry_message: The igniter cracks on nothing and the nozzle coughs a thin unlit mist across the floor.
__own.reload_message: You crack the spent canister out of the tank, seat a fresh one on the bayonet collar, and wait for the pressure light. It goes green.
